purpose: Second S4 conflict-closure batch. Selector-level semantic readiness remains a separate fail-closed gate.

The family-level mapping reuses cw721-drop only for ERC721 ownership/approval/transfer dependency classes in this owner-scoped namespace. Selector-specific/custom application behavior remains opaque and must pass the later semantic-conflict gate.
